auditor_kim: Quick SOC2 ask: we need an evidence bundle for the RBAC change + KMS usage during the 2025-01-09 maintenance window. Items: approval trail, PR diff, infra apply log, k8s audit lines for RoleBinding change, CloudTrail KMS events (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt), and key rotation proof. A README mapping files -> CC6/CC7 would be ideal.

leo_sre: got it. I'll grab kube audit slice for namespace `inference-prod` from 2025-01-09T01:30:00Z to 02:30:00Z, plus the CI deploy log. Prefer jsonl exports?

auditor_kim: jsonl is perfect. Please include checksums (sha256) and a small timeline.txt linking PR -> CI job -> kube patch -> KMS event.

marta_sec: context: change added `serviceAccount: inference-runner` to ClusterRoleBinding `inference-deployers` and we rotated alias/redwood-inf-cache as a precaution. KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz11-2233-4455.

dev_raj: PR: #4580 (sha: f1a2b3). Terraform run: tf-apply-20250109-12; deploy_id=20250109-12. I kicked the apply and approved in Okta (okta_evt=evt-50109-7).

ops-bot: tf-apply-20250109-12 completed; status: success; changes: +1 service_account; run_url: https://ci.redwood/internal/9012.

leo_sre: sample sanitized k8s audit line I'll include: {"stageTimestamp":"2025-01-09T01:47:11Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"dev_raj","uid":"U-998"},"objectRef":{"resource":"clusterrolebindings","name":"inference-deployers"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-runner}]"}}

marta_sec: sample CloudTrail KMS event (sanitized): {"eventTime":"2025-01-09T01:48:30Z","eventName":"GenerateDataKey","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/runner"},"resources":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/zz11-2233-4455"],"requestParameters":{"encryptionContext":{"deploy_id":"20250109-12","pr_sha":"f1a2b3"}}}

leo_sre: plan: assemble bundle -> README.md (file->SOC2 mapping), timeline.txt, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-kms.jsonl, terraform-apply.log, pr-diff.patch, okta-events.jsonl, checksums.sha256. Uploading to s3://redwood-audit/fieldwork/2025-01-09/1795554321_bundle.zip.

auditor_kim: please redact ciphertext blobs and annotate redactions in README. One-line signed approval from approver helps for ISO mapping too.

dev_raj: added short approval note and exported Okta event. I'll sanitize logs and compute sha256. Will DM presigned link when uploaded.

ops-bot: bundle uploaded: 1795554321_bundle.zip; size: 2.1MB; sha256: c5d4e6...; presigned link shared via DM.

auditor_kim: received. We'll review and request any raw traces if needed. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
